documents.fact_summary: Measuring equipment must be calibrated against certified international or national measurement standards.
documents.fact_content: When measurement traceability is an audit requirement, measuring equipment shall be calibrated or verified, or both, at specified intervals, or prior to use, against measurement standards traceable to international or national standards. In Odoo, this is tracked in the Maintenance and Quality modules via periodic calibration work orders and calibration certificate attachments.

metadata.odoo_process: Periodic calibration validation for measuring tools and test equipment

documents.fact_summary: Organizations must identify and control outputs through unique traceability throughout production and delivery.
documents.fact_content: The organization shall use suitable means to identify outputs when it is necessary to ensure the conformity of products and services. The organization shall identify the status of outputs with respect to monitoring and measurement requirements throughout production and service provision. In Odoo, this is managed via Lot/Serial Number tracking across manufacturing orders, inventory moves, and delivery slips.

metadata.odoo_process: Lot and Serial Number tracking on manufacturing and stock moves

documents.fact_summary: Formal user access registration and de-registration process must be implemented to manage user access rights.
documents.fact_content: A formal user registration and deregistration process shall be implemented to enable assignment of access rights. User privileges must be revoked immediately upon employee role termination. In Odoo, user security groups, access control lists (ir.model.access), and record rules (ir.rule) enforce principle of least privilege, synchronized with HR employee active status.

metadata.odoo_process: User onboarding, access group assignment, and deactivation
